records.text: The writer jumps in, it's true, she's enigma right down to her clothes. The first time we met in the lobby of the Waldorf Astoria Hotel in Washington, the morning of the White House correspondence dinner, I came dressed in my best Jackie O (Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis) impression, conservative shift dress, ballet flats, and an overcoat.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
